meta.title: RFQ: keep the same price (100 → 100)
gaps: The exact event-list search-and-open flow for the named RFQ cannot be used because the prepared event must be opened directly and has no named title.
warnings: resolved: “The vendor portal's revision history cannot be inspected to distinguish no new revision from a saved revision 2.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser
can only test part of this — no step for: The exact event-list search-and-open flow for the named RFQ cannot be used because the prepared event must be opened directly and has no named title.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ on the buyer side; this is the required starting point for the existing event.
Add the second bid at 90 so the event matches the two-bid comparison while keeping the prepared vendor's 100 bid available for revision.
Confirm the buyer-side surrogate bid at 90 was accepted.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal, where Vendor A's existing bid can be revised.
Resubmit the vendor's bid at the unchanged price of 100, exercising the revise/edit submission.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the RFQ bid as submitted after the same-price revision.
Return to the buyer's project page to inspect the resulting bids.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the revised RFQ.
Confirm both the vendor's direct bid and the surrogate bid are visible to the buyer.
Open Master QCS to verify the comparison values after revision.
Confirm the comparison grid contains two real vendor columns.
Verify the revising vendor's RFQ rate remains 100.
Verify the other bid remains 90, preserving the two-bid comparison.
